links.comparator_used: Prompt A (brochure prompt without a sixth-grade reading-level instruction)
links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated TED patient education brochures (FKGL, SMOG); also quality, understandability, accuracy, empathy
links.effect: Prompt B (sixth-grade instruction) was easier to understand than prompt A; no significant differences in quality (DISCERN >=4), understandability (PEMAT >=70%), accuracy (>=4) or empathy (>=4). Numeric readability scores not given in the abstract.
links.quote: Regarding readability, prompt B was easier to understand than prompt A, although the optimized version of prompt B still did not reach the ideal readability level.
